name: What evidence is important for a spinal cord injury case?

mainEntity.name: What evidence is important for a spinal cord injury case?

acceptedAnswer.text: Crucial evidence in a spinal cord injury case includes medical records, diagnostic imaging (MRI, CT scans), accident reports, witness statements, and photographs or videos from the scene. Documentation of your injuries, treatment, and ongoing care is vital. Additionally, proof of lost income, property damage, and any expenses related to your injury strengthens your claim. Your lawyer will help you identify, gather, and preserve all necessary evidence.
acceptedAnswer.description: Important evidence includes medical records, accident reports, witness statements, photos, and documentation of all related expenses and losses.
